name: PJBumi Berhad
overview: PJBumi Berhad 今年通过子公司 PJBumiHES 与 INTLEF Horizon Pressure Control (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd 签订合资协议，并通过间接子公司 Rig Capital Pte. Ltd. 与 Gaoyou Hao Xiang Petroleum Machinery Co., Ltd 签订钻机销售合同，涉及工业机械与设备板块。公司同时进行多项股本集资及股份拆分/合并活动。最新季度营收同比大幅增长，但公告中未说明具体业务驱动。
overview_en: PJBumi Berhad this year entered into a joint venture agreement between its wholly-owned subsidiary PJBumiHES and INTLEF Horizon Pressure Control (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd, and a drilling rig sales contract between its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Rig Capital Pte. Ltd. and Gaoyou Hao Xiang Petroleum Machinery Co., Ltd, involving the Industrial Machinery & Equipment segment. The company also carried out several fund-raising exercises and share subdivision/consolidation activities.

segments.name: 工业机械与设备
segments.note: 今年通过合资协议及钻机销售合同，涉及油气田机械及钻机业务。
segments.note_en: This year, through a joint venture agreement and a drilling rig sales contract, the segment is involved in oil and gas field machinery and drilling rig business.
